fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on projected 2009 fuel usage, such an increase would result in an increase to aircraft fuel expense of approximately $399 million in 2009, inclusive of the impact of effective fuel hedge instruments outstanding at December 31, 2008

instrument_type_details.notes: Uses jet fuel and heating oil hedging contracts (NYMEX Heating oil). Net gains in fuel expense 2008: ~$380M; 2007: ~$239M; 2006: ~$97M. Fair value at Dec 31, 2008: ($450)M (liability position) — large loss as fuel prices collapsed in H2 2008. Company modified portfolio in Q4 2008, effectively settling certain 2009 hedges via collars with two counterparties; also had terminated contracts with bankrupt counterparty. Dec 31, 2008 company estimates $711M in net incremental EXPENSE to be reclassified from AOCI in next 12 months.

warnings: Fuel consumption in gallons not explicitly stated; only dollar-based sensitivity disclosures provided.
Pct hedged as of 'January 2009' (early 2009), not as of Dec 31, 2008.
Fair value is NEGATIVE ($450M liability) at Dec 31, 2008 — fuel prices collapsed in H2 2008, turning a large asset position into a large liability.
Some 2009 hedges were effectively unwound in Q4 2008 via counteractive collar trades with two counterparties.
Bankrupt counterparty contracts terminated in 2008; losses to be recognized as fuel expense over time.
